verdict.rationale: Entra documents its own automation that acts on many identities: lifecycle workflows run processes automatically against users as they move through their lifecycle, and SCIM provisioning automatically syncs users and groups into apps. Neither is described as a user-initiated bulk operation, so this is only glancing support for the story. Missing for 10: explicit bulk create/update/delete of users or groups (e.g., CSV bulk operations), API batch request support, and documented limits or results reporting for bulk jobs.
